result.stdout:
Usage: fop <input.fo> <output.{pdf|txt|md|html}>
       fop -fo <input.fo> -pdf <output.pdf>
       fop -xml <data.xml> -xsl <style.xsl> -html <output.html>

The output format is taken from the output file extension, or a format flag below.

Options:
  -fo <file>        XSL-FO input document
  -xml <file>       XML source to transform (with -xsl) into XSL-FO
  -xsl <file>       XSLT stylesheet that produces XSL-FO from the -xml source
  -pdf <file>       PDF output (the default format)
  -txt <file>       plain-text output
  -md <file>        Markdown output
  -html <file>      HTML output
  -fontdir <dir>    register all TTF/OTF fonts in <dir> (repeatable, PDF only)
  -native           use the native (PdfSharp-free) PDF renderer
  -version          print the version and exit
  -help             print this help and exit
